summary: Create an instance group under Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Instance Groups > Create group > Create instance group: unique name (not 'controller'), Policy instance minimum and percentage (default 0), and Max concurrent jobs and Max forks limits (0 means no limit).
questions: How do I create an instance group?
What does Policy instance percentage do?
Can I name an instance group controller?
How do I limit concurrent jobs on an instance group?

answer_card.title: Create an instance group
answer_card.answer_md:
**Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Instance Groups > Create group > Create instance group**:

- **Name**: unique, and not `controller`
- **Policy instance minimum** / **Policy instance percentage**: instances auto-assigned as they come online (default 0)
- **Max concurrent jobs** and **Max forks**: capacity limits; `0` means no limit

Then use the **Instances** tab > **Associate instance** to add instances.
